claims: Luke Murray is Bill Murray's son.
Luke Murray has served as a key assistant coach for the UConn Huskies men's basketball team under Dan Hurley since 2021.
Bill Murray has attended multiple NCAA tournament games, including the Final Four, to support Luke Murray and the UConn Huskies men's basketball team.
Luke Murray helped lead UConn to back-to-back national championships in 2023 and 2024.
Luke Murray stated that he and his father do not have a typical father-son dynamic.
Luke Murray stated that his father is incredibly supportive of his coaching career.
As of April 2026, Luke Murray is leaving UConn to become the new head coach at Boston College.
